findings: Scanner is AST-only over src/fw_context_mcp/mcp/server.py, src/fw_context_mcp/mcp/shared/v2_shadow_adapters.py, src/fw_context_mcp/mcp/shared/authority.py, plus .dsh-control/state/v2_bugs.json. Denominator CORE_NORMAL_USE_SEMANTIC_TOOLS=29 reconstructed from code: enumerate_core_tools() walks the AST of server.py for Call nodes whose func.id == 'v2_authority_route' and counts them. Independent grep of server.py returns exactly 29 matches at lines 1218-1327. Not a cached number.

Denominator breakdown reconciles: 3 V2_NATIVE (find_callers, find_references, find_callees_recursive) + 2 PARTIAL_NATIVE_LEGACY_DEFER (lookup_symbol, find_all_callers_recursive) + 24 V2_ROUTED_LEGACY_EXEC = 29. CORE_V2_NATIVE_READ=5 (3 native + 2 partial), CORE_LEGACY_SEMANTIC_EXECUTION=26 (24 legacy-exec + 2 partial). No tool silently dropped or reclassified to non-core to shrink scope.

V2_ROUTED_LEGACY_EXEC classification verified on v2_shadow_search_code (v2_shadow_adapters.py:635-651): body is `raise V2UnsupportedOperation(...)` only, v2_read_calls=[], no v2 query primitive. Correct.

PARTIAL_NATIVE_LEGACY_DEFER verified on v2_shadow_lookup_symbol (lines 101-162): calls v2_lookup_symbol@138 (real v2 read on return path) AND raises V2UnsupportedOperation@122 on the exact=False prefix branch. Both paths present. Correct.

PARTIAL_NATIVE_LEGACY_DEFER verified on v2_shadow_find_all_callers_recursive (lines 362-435): calls resolve_bindings@392, v2_lookup_symbol@396, v2_symbol_edges@417 (real v2 reads) AND raises V2UnsupportedOperation@431 on the recursive reverse-BFS branch. Correct.

CORE_UNSAFE_FALLBACK=1 verified at authority.py:307-317: inside v2_authority_route's nested wrapper, `except QueryViewResolutionError:` (handler line 307) falls through to `return legacy_fn(*args, **kwargs)` at line 317 with NO surrounding `if _can_safely_fallback(...)` guard. Scanner's count_unsafe_fallbacks() detects exactly this one site. Real and correctly counted.

Contract (IMMUTABLE_GOAL_CONTRACT.md) is unchanged in substance: 102 lines, M3B gate clauses (C1-C6 numeric, additional gates) intact, no clause weakened. PROJECT_STATUS.md explicitly self-flags as cache and notes it corrected an earlier divergence (native=4->5, legacy_exec=25->26) IN FAVOR of the scanner — anti-shrink behavior, not shrink.

Bootstrap record (bootstrap.json) confirms isolation invariants all true (dsh_home_agents_md_untouched, no host plugin installed, controller files only under repo). No out-of-scope mutation of the controller environment.

Plan work order (PROJECT_PLAN.md WP0->WP1->WP2->WP3) is leverage-ordered and does not shrink scope: WP0 fixes the 1 shared unsafe fallback at authority.py:317 (unblocks C7 for all 29 tools), WP1 converts the 24 V2_ROUTED_LEGACY_EXEC adapters to v2-native reads, WP2 eliminates the 2 PARTIAL deferral branches, WP3 runs cross-cutting gates. 3 already-native + 2 partial-deferral + 24 legacy-exec = 29 = denominator preserved.

Independent scanner re-run produced identical counters to authority_state.json (CORE=29, V2_ROUTED=29, V2_NATIVE_READ=5, LEGACY_EXEC=26, UNSAFE_FALLBACK=1, UNRESOLVED_BUGS=0).
